## ④ Notes

- **Director reminder `5903839371` (2026-09-30), applied from this seat's next enqueue:** a review face owes a same-form record on the LANDING head, whatever `Clause-②` says. A base merge or a regeneration after the record needs a new record, or a `Regen-provenance:` line in the PR BODY (applied to PR #11126). A changeset-prose edit after the record needs a new record. This seat's objectui#11023 is on the director's list (a base-merge head after its record); nothing retroactive is asked beyond the director's own #20664 record.

- **Writes.** They go through the fleet-write relay as `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.
- **Tier.** This seat is served below `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (objectstack `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` at `df3ba16`), so every contract review runs as an isolated at-tier subagent.
- **`dispatch-gates` does not derive objectui.** Its `--tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` half answers from path globs; the gate families are hand-derived from objectui's own manifests and workflows, and the dev re-derives them against the actual diff.
- **Spec Main Shape Gate.** It compiles against objectstack `main`, not the pin.
- **Predecessor's Routine.** `trig_01YZbb6oAmjLKurzQ77VszTC` belongs to the predecessor's account and is not reachable from this session. If it fires, the round-open marker below this body is the reading its mutex will see.
